nom: Naked Sundays Beauty Barrier Mineral Perfecting Priming Lotion SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are split: several say it doesn't fully dry down on oily areas like the T-zone and needs setting powder to control shine, while other reviewers with oily skin say it surprised them by not feeling greasy or heavy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as hydrating and well suited to their skin, though a couple note it clings to dry, flaky patches such as around the nose.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, some of whom also describe their skin as sensitive or acne-prone, report no breakouts and comfortable, non-greasy hydration.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are sharply split: several who bought after the recent reformulation report their face turned red and burning or their eyes stung, while other reviewers using the current formula say it doesn't irritate their sensitive skin at all.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who mentions mature skin, paired with dry skin, found the current formula hydrating and recommends it for dry skin.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who addresses normal skin says the thick, almost paste-like texture works well for normal-to-dry skin once warmed between the fingers.

concerns.aging: The few reviewers who mention aging report smoother-looking skin and visibly softened fine lines with use, and the one reviewer with mature skin found the formula hydrating for her skin.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, describe the lotion as hydrating and moisturizing throughout the day; a couple note it clings to dry, flaky patches such as around the nose, making them more noticeable.
concerns.redness: Reports split into two groups: several reviewers say the recently added chemical filters left their face red and burning or their eyes stinging, while others credit the Centella Asiatica in the formula with calming their usual redness, including one reviewer with rosacea who says it didn't trigger a flare-up.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe the formula as soothing and supportive of the skin barrier, though without giving a specific before-and-after detail.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as acne-prone consistently report no new breakouts or clogged pores, with one saying it 'bettered' her skin compared to other SPFs that break her out.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin are divided: some say it needs setting powder to keep oil and glow in check through the day, while others report being surprised that it didn't feel greasy or shiny despite their oily skin.

aspects.libelle: Recently reformulated with added chemical filters
Thick, heavy texture that takes effort to blend
Layers well under makeup without pilling
Temporary white cast on deeper skin tones

extraits.texte: This had been my go to sunscreen for my face. I have very sensitive skin and can't use any sort of chemical sunscreen or anything containing niacinamide (which unfortunately everybody seems to be adding to their products) . when I received my latest order of the sunscreen and applied it in the morning, I noticed by afternoon my face was red and burning. Couldn't figure out at first what caused it but then I checked the ingredients on the sunscreen I noticed it was no longer 100% mineral. Very deceptive on the companies part. They may think we won't notice the reformation, but my skin definitely did. and to top it off, they increased the price substantially. I will definitely be looking for a replacement.

The Beauty Barrier Mineral Perfecting Priming Lotion by Naked Sunday gives you glowing skin, sun protection, and blurs. This lightweight zinc-based lotion can be worn alone or under makeup. I prefer wearing it under makeup because it has a tint that is too dark for my fair skin tone. It has SPF 50 with a velvety satin-smooth finish. The formula is thick, so make sure to blend the lotion well. The ingredients used are Centella Asiatica, Zinc Oxide, Watermelon Extract, and Rice Amino Acids. If you have dry skin, this lotion does attach to dry patches. I have sensitivity around my eye area, and my eyes were watering. The squeeze tube packaging is colorful as well as easy to use. I received this product as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I regret not getting as many day time hours with this product as I would have liked, but I am (unfortunately) on a night shift rotation at work.With that being said, I did get some time with this product—and I have some thoughts. To start, this formula is rather thick and feels heavy on the skin until it dries down. The flip side to that is that it never really dried down on my T zone. That area felt extremely greasy to me all day/evening. Once it finally dried down on the rest of my face, this product did feel rather weightless.During the few daylight hours I did have with this product while doing some yard work , I didn't burn at all—despite the fact that I am rather pale. All in all, I would definitely recommend this product to those of us with dry to combo skin, but definitely not to those with oily skin. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I love this sunscreen. I love that it's not white so I never feel like it's making me look ghostly. I really like the thick texture of the sunscreen. It applies nicely and I've started mixing it with my moisturizer as a 2 in 1. It makes me feel glowy and I like knowing I'm protected from the sun as we move into spring and summer. A definite add to the daily morning routine. I will say of you don't like a thick consistency then this will it be for you. It takes some work to get it to run in and spread but for me I like that. I have a super dry nose and it does kind of make my nose look dry because of the flaky skin I have so keep that in mind but it's not enough to make it where I won't use it. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This is now my favorite SPF ar Ulta! I was previously using Elta MD Elements tinted SPF until i found this one. I love that they reformulated this SPF. It feels nice ans hydrating on my face. I have dry and mature skin dor reference. I am on my 2nd bottle now. I have been lucky, as it has been on sale for most of the summer. I definitely recommend if uoi have dry skin. :)

I've been using the BeautyBarrier Perfecting Priming Lotion SPF50 for about a week now and it's been really easy to add into my morning routine. My skin is combination and can get a bit sensitive, so I'm usually careful with SPF products. This one feels really comfortable right away. The texture is more like a light lotion than a typical sunscreen and it spreads easily without feeling thick or leaving a white cast.What I noticed first was how smooth my skin looked after applying it. It gives a soft blurred look that helps even things out before makeup. On days when I don't feel like wearing foundation I'll just use this on its own and my skin still looks more put together. When I do wear makeup it sits nicely on top and doesn't separate or look patchy.I also like that it doesn't feel heavy or clog my pores. I haven't had any breakouts while using it and my skin feels calm and hydrated during the day. It doesn't completely stop oil but it keeps things balanced enough where I'm not overly shiny. It's simple and does a few things at once without making my routine complicated, which is why I keep reaching for it. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

extraits.titre: Great for priming with added protection!
extraits.texte: I really enjoy using this primer every day since I got it. It is SUPER important to me that I wear sunscreen every day weather it is in a primer or a sunscreen. I love that this adds extra benefits though on top of sun protection. It totally smooths some of my fine lines. You can see from the first picture to the second, my skin looks MUCH more smooth. It does add a slight tint and slight coverage. If you have a rosacea like me I would not expect it to cover all the redness. Good news though, it did NOT trigger my rosacea or irritate it. It does have a slight sunscreen smell but other than that it is unscented. Overall, I have immensely enjoyed this apart of my daily routine alone or with additional makeup!
